title: June 2021 FreeBSD Developer Summit: Raid-Z Expansion
summary: Matt Ahrens presents the FreeBSD Foundation sponsored RAID-Z Expansion project for ZFS at the June 2021 FreeBSD Developer Summit. It explains how a RAID-Z vdev can be grown by adding disks on the fly.
why: HN points to it as the video explanation of how RAID-Z expansion works without block pointer rewrite.

quote.text: For those that like videos more than text, there is a youtube video from last year [1] that explain the feature
